Summary top

Summary top

Summary top is a useful widget for displaying key read-only information at the top of your page. For consistency we prefer you to use the default version. Please refer to the Attributes table for all available options

Vertical display

Vertical display (displayBlock="true)"

Attributes
Element Attribute Type Default
aa-summary-top N/A Component N/A
aa-summary-top displayBlock Boolean false
aa-summary-top verticalDisplay Boolean false
aa-summary-top-list [highlight] Boolean False
aa-summary-top-list [divider] Boolean False
aa-summary-top-list itemTitle String Your title
aa-summary-top-list itemDescription String Your Descripton
aa-summary-top-list truncate Boolean False
aa-summary-top-list maxWidth (Only if using truncate) Number Your number

Default (most used)

Block display (blockDisplay="true")
