Ui block

A simply UI block with custom description. Used to block the user from making changes to the entire page

Attributes
Element Attribute Type Default
aa-ui-block showUiBlock Boolean True
aa-ui-block topPos Any 3.5rem

aa-ui-block allCaps Boolean True
aa-ui-block message String Your message
aa-ui-block zIndex Number 1
